author: Damian Curti
geometry: Original dimensionless controls and owned closed anatomy/garment/native animation tools.
limits: Distinct owned-reference forms: adult female reptile-centaur Xalpen with four legs and long tail; pale-green skull-orb Luz Mala with flame wisps and no limbs; childlike amber Anchimallen with short hair, ivory tunic and bare feet; adult female-faced feathered serpent-dragon Huayrapuca with long neck, four legs, two wings and long tail. Fixed garments/light-colored materials are art; no shared taxonomy, new lighting mechanics, metric scale, powers, rules, inventory or cultural claims.
